source: Final capstone PDF, 22 November 2026, Table 4 concept traceability and Table 5 groupings; report author subsequently confirmed Bensaid et al. (2026) for C04 and Middleton et al. (2022) for C09; representative supporting citations, not paper counts.

concepts.name: Activity Scope, Complexity & Task Fit
concepts.description: Assess the activity’s type, scope, complexity, decomposability, feasibility and AI-task fit.
concepts.source: Hou et al. (2024); Zhang et al. (2026); Erer et al. (2025); Milliken et al. (2025)

concepts.name: Context Sufficiency & Acquisition
concepts.description: Assess whether AI receives or can obtain sufficient, relevant and consistent repository/project context.
concepts.source: Zhang et al. (2025); Liu et al. (2026); Sonkin & Tudose (2025); Hindi et al. (2026)

concepts.name: Environment Dependence & Engineering Readiness
concepts.description: Assess repository/environment readiness, dependencies, domain constraints and supporting engineering infrastructure required for the activity.
concepts.source: Milliken et al. (2025); Anderson (2026); Pandey et al. (2025); Madani et al. (2025)

concepts.name: Workflow Integration & AI Operating Mode
concepts.description: Assess where and how AI participates in the engineering workflow, including its role across implementation, testing, review and integration.
concepts.source: Madani et al. (2025); Kapetanovic et al. (2026); Sonkin & Tudose (2025); Selvanayagam & Ghaleb (2026); Bensaid et al. (2026)

concepts.name: Functional / Specification Alignment & Defect Risk
concepts.description: Assess whether AI-generated changes align with requirements/ specifications and avoid functional, logic or consistency defects.
concepts.source: Tian et al. (2025); Hindi et al. (2026); Erer et al. (2025); Gong et al. (2026)

concepts.name: Security Risk & Assurance
concepts.description: Assess whether AI-assisted changes introduce security risk and what security-assurance mechanisms are applied.
concepts.source: Khan et al. (2026); Sun et al. (2026); Liu et al. (2026); Enyedi (2026)

concepts.name: Maintainability & Performance Quality
concepts.description: Assess maintainability, code quality, performance efficiency, and whether relevant non-functional quality characteristics are adequately evaluated
concepts.source: Sun et al. (2026); Liu et al. (2026); Peng et al. (2025); Watanabe et al. (2026)

concepts.name: Validation Mechanisms & Test Adequacy
concepts.description: Assess whether the activity has appropriate validation mechanisms and sufficiently strong testing to detect relevant failures.
concepts.source: Yang et al. (2026); Khan et al. (2026); Hachaïchi & Ouerghi (2025); Hindi et al. (2026)

concepts.name: Validation Feedback & Iterative Refinement
concepts.description: Assess whether validation or review findings are fed back into the activity to refine the output and whether revised outputs are revalidated.
concepts.source: Alrashedy et al. (2025); Blyth et al. (2025); Anderson (2026); Ogenrwot & Businge (2026)

concepts.name: Human Review, Approval & Oversight Placement
concepts.description: Assess where human review, approval or intervention is required within the AI-assisted activity.
concepts.source: Watanabe et al. (2026); Sardar et al. (2026); Sonkin & Tudose (2025); Ogenrwot & Businge (2026); Middleton et al. (2022)

concepts.name: Autonomy, Permissions & State-Change Authority
concepts.description: Assess how much operational authority AI has, what tools/actions it can access, and what state-changing actions it is permitted to perform.
concepts.source: Hasan & Biswas (2026); Kapetanovic et al. (2026); Parthasarathy et al. (2025); Sardar et al. (2026)

concepts.name: Guardrails, Safe Halt, Rollback & Recovery
concepts.description: Assess whether technical guardrails can constrain unsafe actions and whether failed or undesirable changes can be halted, reversed or recovered from.
concepts.source: Hasan & Biswas (2026); Sonkin & Tudose (2025); Hindi et al. (2026); Ning et al. (2026)

concepts.name: Monitoring, Traceability & Evidence Provenance
concepts.description: Assess whether AI-assisted work is observable and traceable, with evidence showing what occurred, who/what performed actions, validation outcomes, and when reassessment may be needed.
concepts.source: Anderson (2026); Enyedi (2026); Xie et al. (2024); Pandey et al. (2025)

concepts.name: Reviewer Independence, Trust & Automated Oversight
concepts.description: Assess whether review provides sufficiently independent oversight, particularly when AI-generated work is also reviewed by AI, and what level of trust can be placed in automated review.
concepts.source: Selvanayagam & Ghaleb (2026); Ogenrwot & Businge (2026); Gong et al. (2026); Hindi et al. (2026)

concepts.name: Agent Orchestration & Interface Controls
concepts.description: Assess whether agent/sub-agent coordination, tool interactions and interfaces are controlled sufficiently to prevent coordination or interface failures.
concepts.source: Ning et al. (2026); Hasan & Biswas (2026); Parthasarathy et al. (2025); Ștefănescu & Aciobăniței (2026)
